Package main.java.progOO2.p14

package main.java.progOO2.p14

Programming Object Oriented II: Multiplier

This package introduces the concept of passing parameters to methods and using instance fields in calculations. The Multiplier class stores a number and provides a method to multiply it by another number passed as a parameter.

Key learning goals:

  • Encapsulation: The field number is private, enforcing controlled access.
  • Method parameters: The multiply(int number) method demonstrates how input parameters can interact with object state to produce a result.
  • Reusability: The same object can be reused to perform multiple calculations with different arguments.

This exercise reinforces how objects can combine internal state with external parameters to perform computations and return values.
